name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible at all times, so users never hunt for labels while scanning data. The trade-off is a narrower data area, but clarity beats screen real estate when users need to interpret trends fast.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still steals 15% of the screen at all zoom levels—users miss the data they came to see. Instead, make the legend a single, always-visible icon that expands on hover; it’s compact until needed. Settle it with a 5-user usability test: measure time to interpret a dense graph with each design.
